Subject: MAP draft + next milestone: Load/perf test scheduling

Hi Sarah / Toby —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Per our discussion I attached a draft MAP (HelixPay_MAP_v1.xlsx) with the milestones we agreed on. The next critical milestone is scheduling the load/performance test so we can validate sizing for Dedicated capacity and the traffic replay configuration.

High-level ask: can you confirm a preferred testing window (US Pacific time) and a reachable QPS target for peak hours? You mentioned peak checkout QPS around 1,200 and a 99th percentile latency SLA target of ~200ms — I want to make sure we size the Dedicated pool and plan the traffic replay to cover the right envelope.

Proposed options (pick one):
- Option A: Dry-run traffic replay (non-prod) — 2026-08-17 10:00–13:00 PT — target peak 1,200 QPS (gradual ramp)
- Option B: Production-like replay (staging with live TLS) — 2026-08-19 20:00–23:00 PT — target peak 1,500 QPS (includes headroom)

Dependencies we flagged in the MAP: test dataset export from HelixPay (pcap or replayable payloads), secure tunnel credentials (for replay agent), and an SE-led test plan to validate slow-path behaviors (KV cache warmup, long context).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm window + QPS + owner for the dataset export
2) Aditya (cc'd) will prepare the traffic-replay runbook and sizing guidance
3) Redwood schedules Dedicated pool and we run a smoke test 24 hours before the rehearsal

I'll update the MAP with the chosen milestone dates when you confirm.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Appreciate the clear options. Internal alignment notes: Toby and I spoke with SRE and they are comfortable with Option B (production-like replay) if Redwood can provide the isolation guidance and the smoke test beforehand. We can commit to providing a sanitized traffic export by EOD 2026-08-13 — format will be replayable JSON payloads (we can also include a short pcap sample if helpful).

Confirming the target: peak 1,500 QPS to include payment gateway bursts; sustained peak window ~10 minutes, but we'd like headroom for spikes. Owner: Toby (cc).

Thanks — quick technical notes from the SE side (Toby + HelixPay SRE team please confirm):

1) Traffic format: replayable JSON payloads are ideal. Please include timestamps and original request ids where possible to preserve distribution. A small sample pcap is helpful for header-level validation; the attachment you mentioned (traffic_replay_sample.pcap) will be enough for our smoke validation.

2) Ramp pattern: start at 10% of target for 5 min, then 25%, 50%, 75%, and hit 100% for a 10-minute sustained window. We'll collect KV-cache warmup metrics separately.

3) Dedicated capacity sizing: for 1,500 peak QPS with your mix (avg tokens per request ~220, 99th p95 token service work), prelim guidance: reserve a medium Dedicated pool (8 x A100-like vGPUs equivalent) + autoscaling headroom to cover +30% spike. We'll finalize after one dry smoke run and an initial full replay. See attached redwood-dedicated-sizing-guidance.pdf for assumptions.

4) Security/ops: provide a short-lived SFTP/secure tunnel creds (we prefer ephemeral keys) so we can pull the replay payloads. We will not retain production data beyond the test window and will sign the mutual NDA addendum if needed.

Proposed schedule based on HelixPay confirmation:
- 2026-08-18 20:00 PT: smoke test (15 mins)
- 2026-08-19 20:00–23:00 PT: full production-like replay (Option B)

If this looks good I'll build the replay runbook and send a calendar invite for the smoke test tomorrow.
